description_en: Queries service endpoints in a specified workspace with paging, and supports filtering by target type, agent, collaboration component, and status
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的服务端点，支持按目标类型、智能体、协作组件和状态过滤
name: ListServiceEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The target type used to filter the results. Valid values: AGENT_VERSION and TEAM_COLLABORATION
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target agent used to filter the results
parameters.help_zh: 按目标智能体 ID 过滤
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the target agent used to filter the results
parameters.help_zh: 按目标智能体版本号过滤
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.help_en: The workspace resource binding ID of the target collaboration component used to filter the results
parameters.help_zh: 按目标协作组件的工作空间资源绑定 ID 过滤
parameters.name: resource_binding_id

parameters.help_en: The collaboration component type used to filter the results. Valid values: MATRIX_CLIENT, MATRIX_FEDERATION, and ELEMENT_WEB
parameters.help_zh: 按协作组件类型过滤。可选值：MATRIX_CLIENT、MATRIX_FEDERATION、ELEMENT_WEB
parameters.name: collaboration_component

parameters.help_en: The service endpoint status used to filter the results. Valid values: CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DEGRADED, DISABLED, and DELETING
parameters.help_zh: 按服务端点状态过滤。可选值：CREATING、READY、UPDATING、DEGRADED、DISABLED、DELETING
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的最大记录数，取值范围为 1~100。不指定该参数时默认返回 20 条
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The cursor used to query the next page. Do not specify this parameter in the first call. For subsequent calls, specify the `nextToken` value returned in the previous call
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的游标。首次调用不指定该参数，后续调用指定上一次返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

accessUrls.description_en: The list of access URLs for the service endpoint
accessUrls.description_zh: 服务端点的访问地址列表

accessType.description_en: The type of the access URL. Valid values: INTERNET and VPC

status.description_en: The status of the access URL. Valid values: CREATING, READY, and DEGRADED

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the access URL status. The specific reason is returned when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 访问地址状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

authentication.description_en: The authentication configuration of the service endpoint

type.description_en: The authentication method. NONE indicates that no authentication is required. API_KEY indicates that authentication is performed by passing an API key in the `x-api-key` request header
type.description_zh: 鉴权方式。NONE 表示无需鉴权，API_KEY 表示通过 x-api-key 请求头传递 API Key 进行鉴权

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC format compliant with RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

effectivePublicAccessEnabled.description_en: publicAccessEnabled 与工作空间公网入向上限叠加后的结果：二者均允许时为 true。仅表示策略目标，不代表公网入口已发布完成，实际状态以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.description_zh: publicAccessEnabled 与工作空间公网入向上限叠加后的结果：二者均允许时为 true。仅表示策略目标，不代表公网入口已发布完成，实际状态以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.title_en: 服务端点公网入向的有效期望值
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.title_zh: 服务端点公网入向的有效期望值

elasticityPolicy.description_en: 仅在服务端点设置过弹性覆盖值时返回，可设置的为 Router 类型服务端点与 GATEWAY_API_WITH_VPC_INGRESS 类型的 DEFAULT 服务端点；未设置覆盖值时不返回该对象，表示继承智能体源配置，不得当作空对象或默认策略。返回时三个字段必全
elasticityPolicy.description_zh: 仅在服务端点设置过弹性覆盖值时返回，可设置的为 Router 类型服务端点与 GATEWAY_API_WITH_VPC_INGRESS 类型的 DEFAULT 服务端点；未设置覆盖值时不返回该对象，表示继承智能体源配置，不得当作空对象或默认策略。返回时三个字段必全

minSandboxCount.description_en: 最小实例数，不小于 0 且不大于 maxSandboxCount
minSandboxCount.description_zh: 最小实例数，不小于 0 且不大于 maxSandboxCount
minSandboxCount.title_en: 最小实例数，不小于 0 且不大于 maxSandboxCount
minSandboxCount.title_zh: 最小实例数，不小于 0 且不大于 maxSandboxCount

elasticityPolicy.title_en: 服务端点生效的弹性策略覆盖值
elasticityPolicy.title_zh: 服务端点生效的弹性策略覆盖值

endpointType.description_en: The type of the service endpoint. DEFAULT indicates a default endpoint created and maintained by the platform. NAMED indicates a named endpoint explicitly created by the user
endpointType.description_zh: 服务端点类型。DEFAULT 表示由平台创建并维护的默认端点，NAMED 表示用户显式创建的命名端点

name.description_en: The name of the service endpoint. The name must be unique within the workspace and be 1 to 128 characters in length
name.description_zh: 服务端点名称。在工作空间内唯一，长度为 1~128 个字符

publicAccessEnabled.description_en: 用户在服务端点上设置的公网入向期望；未设置过的历史服务端点按 true 返回。仅表示配置期望，实际公网地址是否可用以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
publicAccessEnabled.description_zh: 用户在服务端点上设置的公网入向期望；未设置过的历史服务端点按 true 返回。仅表示配置期望，实际公网地址是否可用以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
publicAccessEnabled.title_en: 服务端点公网入向开关的期望值
publicAccessEnabled.title_zh: 服务端点公网入向开关的期望值

regionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the service endpoint resides
regionId.description_zh: 服务端点所在的地域 ID

serviceEndpointId.description_en: The ID of the service endpoint

status.description_en: The status of the service endpoint. Valid values: CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DEGRADED, DISABLED, and DELETING

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the service endpoint status. The specific reason is returned when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 服务端点状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

target.description_en: The target routing configuration of the service endpoint
target.description_zh: 服务端点的目标路由配置

agentId.description_en: The ID of the target agent. This parameter is returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentId.description_zh: 目标智能体 ID。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

agentVersion.description_en: The version of the target agent. This parameter is returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentVersion.description_zh: 目标智能体版本号。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

collaborationComponent.description_en: The type of the collaboration component. This parameter is returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
collaborationComponent.description_zh: 协作组件类型。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

resourceBindingId.description_en: The workspace resource binding ID associated with the target collaboration component. This parameter is returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
resourceBindingId.description_zh: 目标协作组件关联的工作空间资源绑定 ID。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

targetType.description_en: The target type. Valid values: AGENT_VERSION and TEAM_COLLABORATION

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last modification in UTC format compliant with RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned on a single page for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询生效的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned when the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

nextToken.description_en: The cursor for the next page. This parameter is empty if no next page exists
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标。没有下一页时为空

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of service endpoints that meet the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的服务端点总数
